causal_protocol: Use original FIT-only pre-March2014 source normalization and causal last/age caches. Replay each original owner from anchor-23 through query=anchor+64. Both predictors receive only feature prefixes, never raw/targets/future feature rows. Query only original timestamps anchor+0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56. Scoring targets/masks are consulted after both model outputs. No oracle source WRITE keys.
checkpoint_policy: New immutable HISTORY-QUERY016 checkpoints include optimizer/RNG/source/order/recipe/losses/operator fingerprints; fresh-process actual-source replay.

established_work.established_result: Content-addressable external memory is established; actual source time/owner utility must still be tested.

literature_gap.unresolved_TAConly_question: Does query-diverse physical historical-content supervision recover timestamp-specific useful original associative memory beyond matched fastslow and label-blind clock controls?
literature_gap.what_is_not_being_rediscovered: Dense historical-query regression and masked losses are established. This is a preregistered falsification of this original recurrent memory, not a new architecture claim.
